neighbours.label: the subject or auxiliary when a sentence assigns a contrasting role: 'The guests will bring the food, I'll get', 'Your job is to', 'The farmer does have to'
fire: The kids will bring the salad, I'll get the bread.
Pupils do the work, not you. Your job is to watch.
The sheep find their own grass. The shepherd does have to move them.
The band will play the songs, I'll sell the tickets.
Nurses give the shots, not you. Your task is to rest.
The bees make the honey. The keeper does have to collect it.
The boys will wash the car, I'll clean the house.
Coaches run the drills, not you. Your role is to cheer.
quiet: The kids will bring the salad at noon on Friday.
Pupils do the work in class on most days.
The sheep find their own grass. They are small.
The band will play the songs in the park.
Nurses give the shots in the morning.
The bees make the honey. It is sweet.
The boys will wash the car on Sunday.
Coaches run the drills in the gym.

notes: Card: ' only' 2, then ' Your', ' I', ' farmer', 'asp'. Probes: "'ll" 0.63, ' does' 0.45, ' is' 0.39; 'only ever expressed' 0.01; 'bring the food at noon' 0.01. The + pole is ' came', ' who'.
